name: Bones of the Crypt
summary: Gather 4 Crypt Bones from the undead of Floor 1.
startText: Forgemaster Torin can shape Crypt Bone into strong gear. Bring back four pieces.
inProgressText: Four Crypt Bones — Gnashers, Marauders, and Grave Golems carry them.
completionText: Fine material. Check your crafting menu (J) to forge bone weaponry.
